author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Not every AI update needs to be smartest model ever.

Google just rolled out Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, and honestly… it’s not trying to be the best model in the world. It’s designed to be fast, efficient, and cheap. 

I’ve already used it to build a YouTube thumbnail analyzer and it did everything as advertised: fast, more affordable, and easily accessible. 

Have you tried it yet? Let me know in the comments.

And for the full breakdown of this and all the biggest AI model releases and news from the past week, go check out my full video linked here.

#Ai #AInews #gemini #google
title: Why I'm A Fan of Google's New AI Model
